items.title: What's on This Page
items.why:
Red for Lennon, his favorite color. Every picture is the real app with red added; nothing is built yet.

Today the color row has blue, purple, pink, teal, gold, orange and green, in setup and in Settings under Theme, Customize this theme.

items.title: How Much Red?
items.why: A red color colors the buttons, rings and highlights. A red theme also tints the backgrounds and cards deep crimson.

options.label: A red color
options.desc: An eighth circle in the color row, in setup and in Settings.

options.label: A red color and a red theme
options.desc: Also a "Red" theme in the Theme list: bold red and deep crimson.

items.title: On Lennon's Screen
items.why: The same red in both versions. The theme also turns the background deep crimson.

options.label: A different red
options.desc: Say darker or brighter in the notes.

items.title: Start Lennon on Red?
items.why: His tablet is on blue now.

options.label: Switch Lennon to red
options.desc: Once, on his next open. A grown-up can change it in Settings.

options.label: Leave it; a grown-up picks it

items.title: When Should It Go Out?
items.why: The Weezy look (2.34.0) waits for ChatGPT's scale icon. Red is small and can go first.
